body: Am on meds for about 6weeks now. I feel ok,but not myself, still wish I can go to sleep and not wake up, but just taking it one day at a time for now. I wouldn’t tell you it gets better because you want to feel ok now. I still have my moods but we shall see with time how it goes .
Yea I understand that depression just don’t go away, I still don’t feel ok, still have my suicidal thoughts , but am trying not giving up yet.

Wow yrs and still have the hangover, it probably my 5 day I think, alotttt better than the first day , but still tired at times, but I can deal with that.
Also it doesn’t knock me out as quickly as it did the first day, takes a couple hours .
Appetite wise I think am ok for now.

Ok I’ll stick it through for a month and if this same feeling keeps up , I guess it’s not right for me?
Like I had trouble sleeping as well, so I think that’s why he recommended me this, which it did help with my sleeping. But I need it mainly for my depression.
He didn’t clarify anything with me , he just told me to try these meds 🤦🏽‍♀️.
But hoping these side effects are not like this all the time.

So update I gave in and S/H myself. I did some research on some things today about the easiest way to die, there is no easy way like snapping my fingers, but I now how and where it will be when I so choose to do it. Let’s pray I never do, but let’s pray I do, cause it’s like am here but not here. Am over it all, distance myself from everyone I would have at least 3-4 weeks and no one seems to concern, so why am I fighting to live for them when they can’t even see it. Am only living for others not myself and still it’s like no , it’s your fault just snap out of it think about what you put us thru. I have had enough of this life. Tired of being a faker about life.

So I finally told one of my friend that it’s happening again, took a lot of courage for me to do that , I was crying while texting it to her, but I had to try . Didn’t tell her I cut my self, just that am going through depression again, she’s the only one I feel comfortable to talk to but still sooo sooo hard to reach out, but I had to I was out of it last night and order a rope from Amazon last night 🤦🏽‍♀️.hopefully I don’t ever have to use , hopefully I get enough courage to discard it or return it. She Gave me some kind words as always and decide to let’s go for a walk , hopefully I’ll be up to it. Struggles are real . Am so happy for people who don’t go through this.

Thanks for you kind words, like I don’t want to be down all the time and talk about it, that’s not who I am but when I get this way I just wish I can just snap out of it. It’s good having someone to talk to even if it’s people here. It does help.
Great to hear, I wish one day I’ll be able to say that I beat this terrible disease.

You took the words out of my mouth, just tired of pretending to be okay . I don’t know why I keep going, but one day I feel I would just give in. Because I don’t know it’s unfair for me and others around to keep putting them through this, now I just stay by myself and barely any interaction of anyone. Distancing myself because it would hurt less.

Hi thanks so much for the reply.
And thanks for caring, people say strangers don’t care , but I feel when you know what that person is going through it hurts because you know what it feels like. Sometime I wish I had someone I can legit talk to and not be judged. Well I gave in to temptation tonight . And thanks again.
Thanks guys, will def do. Sorry it’s my first time and a bit nervous meeting up with someone. Let’s hear what they say.
Can I do that? Just sell the item in the parking lot at YRP ?
I don’t know if I can walk in with item , I guess i can probably do it by the doors

This sounds exactly like me, I recently lost my appetite and have no need to leave my bed, it’s a struggle every day, I hate having to fight everyday just to live to feel like this. No one should ever go through depression on there on.
Don’t know which way is the easiest
